customer.text: Hi there, and welcome to Rescue Bites! Local restaurants post their surplus food, like wrong orders and end-of-day extras, at up to seventy percent off.
Create a free account, then log in with your email or user name.
You'll see live deals near you, with a countdown showing how long each one is available.
Search by dish, restaurant, city, or ZIP code.
Pick a deal, and choose how many you want.
You see the full total before you order: the food, a small service fee, and any applicable taxes.
Use your Rescue Bites credit, and pay the rest with a saved or new card.
Your card is only held for now. It's charged when you pick up your food.
Done! You get a four-digit PIN. Show it at the counter when you pick up.
Your orders and PINs are always under My orders.
And every order comes with a receipt you can print or download.
That's Rescue Bites. Rescue great food, and save money. Happy rescuing!

restaurant.text: Hi there! Rescue Bites helps restaurants turn surplus food into revenue, in under a minute.
Log in to your restaurant dashboard.
It shows your pickups, offers, menu, orders, and payouts.
To post surplus food, pick a dish from your menu, say why it's available, and choose your discount.
Set how many are available, and a discard timer.
Your offer goes live for nearby customers right away.
When a customer orders, a bell rings, and the order pops up on your screen.
At pickup, type the customer's four-digit PIN.
Check the order and hand over the food. The customer's card is charged, and your share is paid to your Stripe account.
The Payouts tab lists every payment, with its invoice number and transaction ID.
And the daily report shows your sales, with print, PDF, and CSV downloads.
That's Rescue Bites. Less waste, and more revenue. Happy selling!
